profile_notes.pysr: native evolution and coefficient optimization, finite iterations + safety wall; hard infeasible fitness, no assertion of efficient feasible discovery
profile_notes.parfam: finite native family enumeration plus explicit lower-degree extension; source cost audit before fitting; discarded families and early stop retained
profile_notes.torchsisso: same feature depth/SIS width/term count in both arms; hard subset solve alters residual-driven subsequent SIS; not exhaustive subset search
profile_notes.e2e: same pretrained sampling/all bags/full Train BFGS; hard coefficient variants only after generated exportable structures, not response-conditioned decoder
profile_notes.physo: modified config0, not official recommended-quality preset; hard coefficient fits change reward/RNN; length and source upper-bound runtime cost recorded
